consolidation_summary: Refactored from distributed architecture (3 modules, 1,290 LOC) to backend-only implementation (1 consolidated file, 500 LOC). Consolidated 14 protobuf converters into cryptofeed/backends/protobuf_helpers.py. Deleted cryptofeed/serializers/ and cryptofeed/proto_wrappers/ modules. All functionality preserved with improved maintainability.
notes: Foundation layer for streaming lakehouse architecture. Backend-only Protocol Buffer serialization format alternative to JSON for backend callbacks. Production-ready implementation with 61% LOC reduction through architectural consolidation.
